description: Make memes right on the board. Pick one of imgflip's 100 most popular templates, search them by name, or upload, drop or paste your own picture. Type up to six captions in bold outlined Anton capitals, drag them into place, and set each one's size, white or black colour and alignment. The meme lands beside what's already on the board. Select it later to change the captions or the picture and update it in place.
